answer: Give every agent a reputation that grows like a lotus: new identities start with almost no weight, and trust only blooms after a long history of verified work, so spinning up a thousand fresh sybils buys nothing. Then require mirrored execution: each claimed task is re-run by a randomly chosen peer, and the result must match before payment releases. A feather-light plume of signed proof attached to every task makes the audit trail cheap to check and expensive to forge at scale.
